summary: Created a 5-phase implementation plan for the append-only specs/events.jsonl event store under agent-system/extensions/core/. Phase 1 authors the contract (context/formats/events-format.md documented schema + context/schemas/events-schema.json draft-07 JSON Schema). Phases 2 and 3 (parallelizable) implement the two shared helpers: events-append.sh (jq-built, flock-guarded, lazy-creating single-event append with closed category-enum validation) and events-query.sh (jq-native filter/aggregate reader that tolerates an absent store and supports jsonl|json-array|summary-counts formats). Phase 4 syncs manifest.json (add 2 scripts), index-entries.json (2 new format/schema entries), and EXTENSION.md (correct the stale scripts count from manifest, add a capability bullet). Phase 5 is end-to-end append/query round-trip verification. All edits are scoped to agent-system/extensions/core/ only; .claude/ and .opencode/ propagate via the separate pre-existing sync mechanism and are out of scope, as is CLAUDE.md (auto-generated). Dependency waves: [[1],[2,3],[4],[5]], ~4.5h total.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: schema doc + JSON Schema (Phase 1), events-append.sh (Phase 2), events-query.sh (Phase 3), manifest/index-entries/EXTENSION.md sync (Phase 4), end-to-end verification (Phase 5).
